chunks: When they reached the confluence of the two seas, they forgot their fish, which then made its way into the sea by swimming.

key_terms.سَرَبًا: Swimming or making a way by swimming
key_terms.مَجْمَعَ بَيْنِهِمَا: The confluence or meeting point of the two seas

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the fish in the story of Musa and Khidr in Surah Al-Kahf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the pivotal transition from the visible world (zahir) to the hidden realities (batin) of Khidr’s divine knowledge, occurring at the 'junction of the two seas' which symbolizes the meeting point of the material and spiritual realms. The miraculous escape of the fish serves as the specific sign (ayat) for Musa (AS) to begin his journey of learning, illustrating the concept of 'forgetting' (nisiya) not as a lapse in memory but as a divine removal of the physical form to reveal the spiritual guide.
